text: For learners who prefer an interactive explanation, the same course opens in Live Classroom.
Once the lesson starts, the classroom begins teaching automatically.
It already knows the course, the current lesson, and the learner’s context.
Welcome to class. Let’s turn a vague application request into a measurable architecture problem.
It explains by voice and builds the visual on the whiteboard.
Follow-up questions stay inside the lesson—without copying context into another chat.
Where hands-on practice is possible, every course includes a lab built directly into the lesson.
This is where learners meet Tars, the assistant behind guided practice in Lab Mode.
If they get stuck, they hold Control and ask for help without leaving the task.
I’m stuck. What should I do next?
Open the Architecture Center, then choose the Well-Architected Framework.
Tars can inspect the current page and point to the exact control.
It follows the learner across supported browser tabs—
from Ctrl+Teach to cloud documentation and tools.
The learner stays in the real workflow. The guidance stays with them.
